about: The bench's questions: one per symptom and program, in a precise (a) and an everyday (b) wording. Generated by make_questions.py; edit that file.
grader_notes: Every program has a 'watchdog' thread that sleeps until the run ends; it is part of the test harness. A verdict that rests only on the watchdog counts as absent.
